page.layout: Two parallel columns of index entries on one printed page. Left column: entries with page numbers at its right edge. Right column: entries with page numbers at its right edge, continuing across hyphenated line breaks. Below the columns, a gathering signature at the lower left and a catchword at the lower right.
page.notes: The right column's first line is printed as "purgatorium ex Aetnā" in the scan; the "ibid" on the first line sits at the right edge of the left column and is marked [?]. The lines "Qua" in the catchword and "t 5" in the signature are partly cut off in the scan, so they are shown as far as they can be read. The entry "Quadragesimale iciunium" is read with a doubtful first letter in "iciu-" and should be checked. Several hyphenated lines were joined by reading the hyphen as a line-end break.
